::: {.news-list}
- <span class="news-date">2 Nov 2026</span><span class="news-type">Team</span><span class="news-text">Guido Priem joins my NWO project on social norms in immigrant societies at VU Amsterdam as a postdoctoral researcher. <span class="news-links">[Project](projects.qmd#nwo)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">24 Oct 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">“Trading migration?”, with Sandra Lavenex and Paula Hoffmeyer-Zlotnik, is out in *The Review of International Organizations*: economic interdependence and the design of earlier agreements explain why most new trade agreements facilitate business mobility. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11558-026-09654-2)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">14 Oct 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">Our article with Marco Bitschnau on measuring misperceptions about immigration is in print in *Political Science Research and Methods*: most inaccurate answers are uninformed guesses, and genuine misperceptions concentrate among anti-immigrant respondents. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1017/psrm.2025.10055)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">1 Sep 2026</span><span class="news-type">Project</span><span class="news-text">My NWO project “The Normative Integration Regime” starts at VU Amsterdam. <span class="news-links">[Project](projects.qmd#nwo)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">21 Jul 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">“Fair enough?”, with Ben Crum, is out in the *European Journal of Political Research*: citizens in six EU countries support fairer responsibility-sharing, yet favour the principles that minimise their own country’s refugee intake. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1475676526101595)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">8 Jul 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">“Seeing divides”, with Serena Does, is out in *Political Behavior*: citizens’ biased perceptions of the immigration cleavage mirror and reinforce political conflict. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11109-026-10181-4)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">7 Jul 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">“Integration for whom?”, with Stefan Manser-Egli, is in print in *European Societies*: a survey experiment finds double standards in social expectations towards immigrants in German-speaking Switzerland. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1162/euso.a.30)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">22 Jun 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">My article with Diego Caballero-Vélez in *Perspectives on Politics* systematises the benefits states derive from refugee protection as a public good. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1537592724001014)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">17 Jun 2026</span><span class="news-type">Vacancy</span><span class="news-text">Postdoctoral position in my NWO project at VU Amsterdam (now filled).</span>
- <span class="news-date">15 Jun 2026</span><span class="news-type">Data</span><span class="news-text">Version 2 of the MITA dataset covers trade agreements signed until 2024, together with the new MITA Explorer app. <span class="news-links">[Dataset](data.qmd#mita) · [MITA Explorer](https://philipplutz.shinyapps.io/MITA/)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">12 Jun 2026</span><span class="news-type">Media</span><span class="news-text">Ahead of the Swiss vote on a population cap, I spoke to Euractiv about the possible consequences of the initiative. <span class="news-links">[Euractiv](https://www.euractiv.com/news/swiss-vote-on-migration-cap-threatens-eu-ties/)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">18 May 2026</span><span class="news-type">Blog</span><span class="news-text">With Maud Bachelet, I discuss in *DeFacto* whether Switzerland should join the EU’s new solidarity mechanism in asylum policy. <span class="news-links">[Deutsch](https://www.defacto.expert/2026/05/18/soll-sich-die-schweiz-am-eu-solidaritaetsmechanismus-in-der-asylpolitik-beteiligen/) · [Français](https://www.defacto.expert/2026/05/18/la-suisse-doit-elle-participer-au-mecanisme-de-solidarite-du-pacte-de-lue-sur-la-migration-et-lasile/?lang=fr)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">13 May 2026</span><span class="news-type">Article</span><span class="news-text">With Florian Trauner and Philipp Stutz, I show in *European Union Politics* that Dublin transfers make the distribution of asylum responsibility among member states fairer, as a result of uneven compliance with the Dublin rules. <span class="news-links">[Article](https://doi.org/10.1177/14651165261446534) · [Blog post](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/europpblog/2026/05/15/eu-dublin-system-asylum-fairness-statistics/) · [Press release](https://vu.nl/en/news/2026/dublin-asylum-system-fairer-than-assumed-but-not-by-design)</span></span>
- <span class="news-date">5 May 2026</span><span class="news-type">Grant</span><span class="news-text">The Dutch Research Council (NWO) funds my project “The Normative Integration Regime: How Differential Expectations Shape Immigrant Societies”. <span class="news-links">[Press release](https://vu.nl/en/news/2026/grants-open-competition-sgw-xs) · [Project](projects.qmd#nwo)</span></span>
:::
